messages:
tara: Heads-up - SI partner "EdgeWave" sent mixed aggregation levels (minute + hourly) in the same webhook batch. Some customers saw partial entitlements for the hour. Need a quick normalization + partner ask.

billing-bot: [ALERT] mixed_aggregation_detected - partner=edgewave sample_count=7 first_seen=2026-03-22T02:12:05Z

mohit: Can we normalize by bucketing minute-level events into the hourly window if window_end aligns? Quick rule: if window_end % 1h == 0 and granularity==minute, map into hourly rollup and mark normalized=true.

zane: Sample payload (redacted):
```json
{"acct":"acct_300","units":120,"unit_type":"tokens","aggregation":"minute","window_end":"2026-03-22T01:00:00Z","event_id":"e-411"}
{"acct":"acct_300","units":480,"unit_type":"tokens","aggregation":"hour","window_end":"2026-03-22T01:00:00Z","event_id":"e-412"}
```

cs-lead: Customer impact - 3 accounts hit quotas during the overlap. CS needs affected-accounts CSV and a short customer note we can use.

tara: Short-term plan: 1) Accept mixed aggregation for matching window_end but set "normalized_by":"aggregation_merge". 2) Run reconciliation for the last 24h for EdgeWave and produce deltas.csv. 3) Ask partner to standardize to one aggregation level per webhook (prefer hourly) and include partner_version header.

mohit: I'll push a small ingestion change + unit test. Also adding a quarantine metric for events missing event_id. If event_id missing, buffer and alert partner.

billing-bot: Recon job queued - job_id=rw_recon_20260322_ew estimated=25m

zane: Draft partner msg: "We observed mixed aggregation levels in the same payload which causes duplicate rollups. We've run a reconciliation and normalized overlapping events. Please send one aggregation level per webhook and include event_id UUIDs. Use our validate script to test." Will send after recon completes.

cs-lead: Please attach deltas.csv to PART-2439 and include customer-facing blurb: "We've applied an adjustment to your usage for the affected hour. No action required from you; reach out if you see discrepancies."

tara: Noted. Keeping thread as source of truth. Will follow up when job_id returns status.

billing-bot: Recon job completed - job_id=rw_recon_20260322_ew status=complete deltas_count=3
